[P2] Account for the submitter's default failure message

When a submitter raises `PaymentError()` without a message, `DurableContext.wait_for_callback()` changes the propagated message to `"Callback submitter failed"`, while the submitter step and enclosing context retain `""`. This index only normalizes callback-operation messages, so the execution error matches no checkpoint and reports `CallbackSubmitterError`, while both operations report `PaymentError`. Account for the submitter default-message substitution during cause matching and add live/replay coverage for an empty-message submitter.
